escalations.title: Config-vs-doctrine drift: manual POS discounts default ON, but the config comments still say 'OFF for V1 until F1 fixed' (F1 IS now fixed)
escalations.file_line: config/pos.php:155-176 (comment block + 'manual_discount_enabled' => env('POS_MANUAL_DISCOUNT_ENABLED', true)) + app/Services/OrderService.php:2877-2888 (stale 'Default OFF for V1' comment)
escalations.evidence: VERIFIED both ways. (1) config('pos.manual_discount_enabled') === bool(true) at runtime (no .env override). (2) The original safety reason for keeping it OFF — the F1 discount->VAT split — IS FIXED: ZReportService carries [LOCK_ZREPORT_F1_DISCOUNT_NETTING] orderDiscountRatio() doing proportional post-discount TVA allocation, and ZReportDiscountNettingTest passes 5/5 ('discounted order z tva is netted to post discount base', 'multi rate discount allocates proportionally', 'total tva exactly equals sum of total by tax rate', 'discounted z close signs and chain verifies'). So a discounted order at 10% VAT signs a CORRECT Z. NO fiscal breach.
escalations.why_it_matters: This is NOT a fiscal P1 (the self-audit disproved that). It is a documentation/config-hygiene drift: the code comments instruct the reader that discounts are OFF-until-F1, while F1 is fixed and the flag defaults ON. A future maintainer reading the stale comment could wrongly believe discounts are disabled, or wrongly re-disable them. The protecting sentinel (ManualDiscountDisabledV1SentinelTest) force-sets the flag false in every test, so it never asserts the production default.
escalations.reproduction: php artisan tinker --execute="var_dump(config('pos.manual_discount_enabled'));" -> bool(true); php artisan test --filter=ZReportDiscountNetting -> 5 passed (F1 fixed)
escalations.recommended_correction: OWNER CONFIRM INTENT (low-risk): (a) confirm manual POS discounts ON is the intended V1 behaviour; (b) refresh the stale 'Default OFF for V1 until F1' comments in config/pos.php + OrderService.php to reflect that F1 is fixed and discounts are intentionally enabled; (c) optionally add a sentinel asserting the runtime default is true so the doctrine and the code agree. No frozen-zone change required.

escalations.title: No cash-in / cash-out (apport / prelevement) write path for the operator — standard NF525 mid-shift drawer op is unrecordable
escalations.file_line: resources/js/components/admin/cash/PosCashDrawerSessionDialog.vue:268-300 (movements view READ-ONLY) + routes/api.php:937 (only GET /{session}/movements) + app/Services/Cash/CashDrawerService.php (recordMovement TYPE_CASH_IN/OUT exists, no POST route)
escalations.evidence: Backend CashDrawerService.recordMovement supports TYPE_CASH_IN/TYPE_CASH_OUT but only a GET movements route exists; the dialog's movements view is loadMovements-only. Mid-shift manual deposits/withdrawals cannot be recorded by the operator.
escalations.why_it_matters: Recording apport/prelevement is a standard NF525 cash-drawer operation; without it the physical drawer and the recorded cash trail drift, undermining reconciliation and the Z cash figure.
escalations.reproduction: Inspect routes/api.php cash-drawer group: no POST movement route; the dialog has no cash-in/out button
escalations.recommended_correction: OWNER decision: add a POST cash-movement route + operator UI (apport/prelevement) OR document that mid-shift movements are out of V1 scope. Backend capability already exists.
